name: Pick and place
definition: Pick up one or more objects and move them to a specified destination, or simply move or carry them, without first changing their state.

name: Clean and place
definition: Clean, rinse, or wash an object or fixture (picking it up only if movable), and place it at a specified destination if one is given; otherwise simply clean it.

name: Cool and place
definition: Pick up an object, cool or chill it, and place it at a specified destination, or simply cool it if no destination is given.

name: Heat and place
definition: Pick up an object, heat, cook, or warm it, and place it at a specified destination, or simply heat it if no destination is given.

name: Fill and place
definition: Pick up an object, fill it with water, and place it at a specified destination, or simply fill it if no destination is given.

name: Use lamp
definition: Turn on or use a lamp or light, optionally while holding an object to illuminate or examine it.
